source.title: ABRL strict contributor/Codex publication contract and generated research surfaces

target: Make collaborator/Codex contributions fail closed unless source/reuse/reader/semantic/route/progress/graph publication obligations are explicitly integrated, while moving Setting Atlas/frontier/GapEntropy pages under the canonical site generator and publishing the first typed Functor Hypergraph memory.

searched_existing: BanditRLlib CONTRIBUTING.md, PR/issue templates, community contribution schema, website generator/layout, Lean Graph, roadmap/results/BanditRLwiki data
Sampling-Optimisation-Geometry-Lib AGENTS.md, collaborator bootstrap, contributor Codex contract, theorem publication protocol, semantic-roundtrip/substantive-advance skills, contributor-contract CI
reuse_plan.decision_reason: Reuse BanditRLlib's existing canonical website/layout/status infrastructure and independently adapt the sibling project's stricter publication ideas to ABRL's own routes, BanditRLwiki, Lean Graph and proof-graph data instead of copying a second site/proof system.

semantic_roundtrip.verdict: not-required: governance/publication infrastructure; no new source theorem is claimed by this manifest
semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: The carried frontier registry retains its own dated source-status semantics; theorem-level source formalizations remain subject to the new independent round-trip contract.

graph_contribution.functor_reason: No new local Lean theorem/dependency is asserted. The research atlas gains generated Setting/frontier/external-bridge surfaces, while four recurring cross-setting proof mechanisms are published only as dashed conceptual candidates with explicit failure boundaries.
graph_contribution.visual_review: Canonical layout and page structure are generator-backed; CI site build/check is required, followed by maintainer browser inspection before merge.

progress_updates.teaching_route: no-change-with-reason: no textbook theorem or chapter completion state is changed by this protocol/infrastructure PR.
progress_updates.banditrlwiki: updated: full Setting Atlas and frontier problem history become canonical generated research surfaces linked directly from BanditRLwiki.
progress_updates.results_ledger: no-change-with-reason: no local theorem milestone gains or loses compiled status.
progress_updates.roadmap: no-change-with-reason: no mathematical frontier route is claimed closed by the contributor-protocol upgrade.

truth_boundary: This PR tightens publication/integration discipline and exposes conceptual graph memory. It does not prove a new Bandit/RL theorem, does not turn GapEntropy external Lean into a local compile, does not certify Functor Hypergraph candidates as mathematical functors, and does not complete any teaching route.
